inputs.label: The House of the Dead 4 arcade files (elf, fs, drv)
inputs.help: Your own copy of the Lindbergh arcade game: the folder that holds elf, fs and drv. The app runs only the game version it was built from.

steps.why: The game reads /sdcard/HouseOfTheDead4. The guide has the user allow All files access on the first start.

steps.text: Open The House of the Dead 4 VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it opens the All files access screen, allow it and start the app again.

notes: lialan/lindbergh-recomp-ports puts several games in one release (Ghost Squad Evolution, Let's Go Jungle, HOTD4 Special) under shared tags, so no tag filter is possible. qgp skips releases without a matching asset, so a newer release that leaves out HOTD4 is fine. The asset pattern does not match HouseOfTheDead4SpecialVR.
